authors: J.L. Bourjaily, S. He, C. Shi, Y. Tang
title: The four-point correlator of planar sYM at twelve loops
claim: The double-triangle rule fully determines the 11-loop planar correlator and fixes all but 3 of the 619,981,403 twelve-loop f-graph coefficients (35,503,735 nonzero); the triangle rule fixes the remaining three. The double-triangle rule is argued to imply the square and pentagon rules.
theory: planar N=4 SYM; four-point stress-tensor correlator and four-point amplitude
scheme: No regularization discussed: integrand-level bootstrap using OPE and light-like divergence structures as constraints.
symmetry_argument: Same as S1c.07_HSTZ2024: hidden permutation symmetry, Lagrangian insertion, cusp (double light-like) and OPE limits.

proved: Computational result: unique solution of the double-triangle + triangle constraints on the 12-loop planar f-graph ansatz (Sec. III, Table 1).
assumed: Implication double-triangle => square and pentagon rules argued via examples, not proved in general (Sec. II.1).
Completeness of the constraints at all loops is open (Sec. V); Catalan conjecture unproven (Sec. IV); appendix formula eq. (8) conjectural.
checked_partially: Graphs without double-triangle subtopology (one at 11 loops, two at 12) fixed by other means (Sec. III, Fig. 1).

evidence: Table 1: f-graph counts (11 loops 22,024,902 / 2,048,262 nonzero; 12 loops 619,981,403 / 35,503,735 nonzero).
Sec. II: double-triangle rule from log x12^2 log x23^2 Sudakov divergence; triangle rule from log x12^2 OPE divergence.
Sec. II.1: square and pentagon rules argued to follow.
Abstract quotes 22,024,902 for 12 loops, inconsistent with Table 1 (that number is the 11-loop count).
red_flags: Integrand-only; no regulator; correctness depends on the bootstrap premises (hidden symmetry, insertion, limits) and their sufficiency.
Minor internal inconsistency in the stated coefficient count (abstract vs Table 1).
notes: Highest loop order (12) for any N=4 four-point integrand found; purely bootstrap. Journal ref from a search snippet only.
